def find_kth_permutation(n, k):
    from math import factorial
    
    # Helper function to get the k-th permutation
    def get_permutation(arr, k):
        if len(arr) == 1:
            return arr
        
        fact = factorial(len(arr) - 1)
        index = (k - 1) // fact
        selected = arr[index]
        remaining = arr[:index] + arr[index+1:]
        
        return [selected] + get_permutation(remaining, k % fact)
    
    # Generate the initial list of numbers from 1 to n
    numbers = list(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # Get the k-th permutation
    result = get_permutation(numbers, k)
    
    # Print the result
    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))
